sources.excerpt: La Pédale d'effet Amptweaker Bass TightRock JR - Photos, Tests & Avis Aller au contenu Menu Menu Matériel Guitares Guitares classiques Guitares acoustiques Guitares électriques Guitares électriques Fender Combos guitares Tête ampli guitares Baffles guitares Amplis de puissance guitares Préamps guitares Micros guitares Cordes guitares électriques Autre matériels guitares Basses Basses acoustiques Basses électriques Combos basses Tête ampli basses Baffles basses Stacks basses Préamps basses Autres instruments à cordes Ukulélé Pédales d’effets Marques Furch Larry Carlton Cours Accords Débutant Accueil - Pédales d’effets La Pédale d’effet Amptweaker Bass TightRock JR – Photos, Tests & Avis 10 juin 2026 17 octobre 2020 Amptweaker Bass TightRock JR Voir plus d’images de la pédale Amptweaker Bass TightRock JR Les caractéristiques de la pédale Amptweaker : Pour basse électrique Distorsion à gain élevé Version miniature du modèle TightRock Noise gate intégré Dry Low Blende Plaque avec vis moletée pour un accès facile à la batterie True Bypass Contrôles: Gain, Tone, Volume, Noise Gate, Dry Low Sélecteur EQ 3 positions: Plexi, Normal, Smooth Sélecteur Tight 3 positions: Fat, Normal, Tight Commutateur au pied Bypass LED de statut Boîtier en métal Entrée et sortie sur Jack mono 6,3 mm Fonctionne avec une pile 9V Bloc d’alimentation 9-18 V DC (fiche cylindrique 2,1 x 5,5 mm, polarité négative à l’intérieur) optionnel non-fourni Consommation: 13 mA avec pile, 15 mA avec bloc d’alimentation Dimensions: 69 x 118 x 51 mm Poids: 255 g Fabriquée à la main aux USA Type d’effet Distorsion   Cette nouvelle pédale Amptweaker Bass TightRock JR est un best-seller qui possède d’admirables attributs et un rapport qualité prix parfait. Nous avons comparé son prix sur les sites de vente de pédales d’effet et le prix le plus bas se situe chez notre partenaire Thomann . Cette magnifique pédale est une référence. Toute l’expertise que la marque Amptweaker a acquis depuis sa création se retrouve dans ce modèle. La magnifique pédale d’effet a un degré de finition remarquable. L’historique de Amptweaker se retranscrit dans cette basse électrique Amptweaker Bass TightRock JR. Elle allie des caractéristiques avantageuses et des matériaux modernes avec l’expertise de la marque Amptweaker pour créer au final une pédale d’effet équilibrée et actuelle. Amptweaker browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal events 2016 Summer NAMM 2016 Amptweaker Bass TightRock Jr. Published on June 19, 2016 Amptweaker distortion pedal Summer NAMM 2016 Information Amptweaker (press release June 17, 2016) Amptweaker Bass Jr Distortion Series Cumming, GA, Jun 17, 2016 The Amptweaker™ JR Distortion Series has been expanded to include bass versions… Introducing the Bass TightDrive Jr™, Bass TightRock Jr™, and Bass TightMetal Jr™. Each mini 'phase 90' sized pedal has the same features as its guitar counterparts, with the Tone and Tight controls shifted down an octave for bass or extended range guitars. Amptweaker's Dry Low blend knob is also included….a very popular feature from the Bass TightFuzz™, which helps maintain the lowend while allowing the distortion to be chunky and tight. The 3-position Tight switch (Fat/Normal/Tight) dials in the attack of the notes from thick and heavy to aggressive and chunky.  An EQ switch similarly provides Plexi(Thrash on TMJR)/Normal/Smooth tone settings, which helps the pedals work with a broad range of rigs.  In addition to Gain, Tone and Volume knobs, there's even a manually-adjustable Noise Gate which can be cranked to stop notes hard and fast….this gate only afects your distorted tone and automatically goes away when the pedal is bypassed. All of the pedals use true bypass switching, operate from 9 to 18VDC with varying dynamics, and have battery access with no tools required. sources.excerpt: Bass TightRock Jr by Amptweaker | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Amptweaker Bass TightRock Jr LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION NOISE GATE Description The Bass TightRock Jr is the bass version of Amptweaker's popular TightRock pedal, and includes a side Dry Low MOD knob. This blend adds in clean lowend to the tone, helping to maintain the bottom without adding weird phase-shifty tones to the distorted highend. Derived from our Pro series, the Tight control and Fat switches were re-configured into a 3-position Fat/Normal/Tight switch to dial in the attack of the notes from thick and heavy to aggressive and chunky. An EQ switch similarly provides Plexi/Normal/Smooth tone settings, which helps the pedals cover much of the range of both their Fat and Tight parents. In addition to Gain, Tone and Volume knobs, there's also a manually-adjustable Noise Gate which can be cranked to stop notes hard and fast. And the great thing about a built-in noise gate is that it goes away when you turn the pedal off...so your clean tone is unaffected! The Tight switch and Tone control were tweaked on these bass versions to operate at lower frequencies, making them perfect for bass OR lower tuned guitars such as 7 or 8-strings. 0 Media Videos Amptweaker Bass TightRock JR demo by MrExcane Amptweaker Bass JR Series official demo Demo by Premier Guitar (EN) Demo by Andertons Music Co (EN) Manual (FR) Manuals Manual (DE) Manual (EN) Reviews Amptweaker Bass Drive - Review By Gitarre&Bass 12-2018 DE (DE) Technical data Width 000.00 mm Depth 000.00 mm Height 000.00 mm Weight 000.00 mm Circuit type analog Voltage 9V DC, center negative Current 13mA More pedals from Amptweaker EQUALIZER EQUALIZER Amptweaker DepthFinder FUZZ FUZZ Amptweaker Bass BluesFuzz Jr OVERDRIVE PREAMP OVERDRIVE PREAMP Amptweaker Bass TightDrive OVERDRIVE NOISE GATE OVERDRIVE NOISE GATE Amptweaker Bass TightDrive Jr All Amptweaker Pedals Products Pedalboards All-In-One Patchbays QuickMount PedalSafe Power Supplies and Power Cables and Connections Accessories Gear Build your own board Board Configurator PedalPedia Pedalboard Gallery QuickMount Finder Services Find a dealer Find a distributor Frequently Asked Questions Contact Current catalog News Community RockBoard Artists Achievements Your Activity Overview ©2026 Warwick GmbH & Co.
